sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Call received from 77 Convenience Store about a vagrant causing a disturbance at the store.

Arrived and spoke to the individual; he was yelling and talking about people leaving rubbish around, and said something about having been assaulted. Standing by after ensuring the person of interest had left the area.
Heading through Federal Street towards Wyndham Street.
Federal Street, St Patrick's Cathedral and the Square all clear; standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart all clear; standing by for security presence.
Call received from Mothership asking for assistance.
No sign of the person of interest; calling back the person who phoned us.

Spoke to the guard working there, known as Mouse. The person is described as stocky build, with hair in three plaits on top, and under the influence. Going to look for the person of interest, since staff were unable to provide footage; checking around Fort Street and Gore Street.
No sign of the person of interest. Heading to the office to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at the HQ office; charging the Ops Phone, which is at 5%.
Heading back on patrol; checking up on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks on Starbucks up to Acceco and NZ Muscle, nothing to report. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square all clear, nothing to report; standing by for security presence.
Heading towards the Library to check in on Lorne Street.
The Library and Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards the Avani Metropolis to check up on the guard.
Arrived on site; commencing welfare checks.
All clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading back on patrol; checking in on High Street.
High Street all clear; heading towards Chancery Square via O'Connell Street.
Welfare checks on Freyberg Square and Chancery Square all clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Queen Street via Shortland Street.
Shortland convenience store all clear; heading down Queen Street.
Welfare check at Q Convenience Store, all clear. Heading to check on Britomart McDonald's.
Britomart McDonald's all clear, nothing to report. Commencing a full sweep of TK Square and Commercial Bay.
Welfare checks completed on TK Square and Commercial Bay; standing by for security presence.
Heading up Albert Street towards Wyndham Street.
Call received from Typo Queen Street; heading there to assist.

Arrived at Typo and spoke to the workers, who gave a description: a male wearing full black clothing with a scarf around his neck, roughly 165cm tall, appearing to be under the influence of either alcohol or narcotics, last seen heading down towards Britomart. Heading down to see if we can find him and retrieve the stolen item.

Response call from the Watch Group that operates the CCTV, asking if we could assist with removing a vagrant sleeping in front of the entrance of the building housing DX Mail on Durham Lane. Advised him we were currently occupied but would assist when available; he was quite understanding.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Queen Street; no sign of the person of interest. Heading back to see if we missed him in the stores or on Vulcan Lane.

No sign of the person of interest. Informed the Typo staff and asked for footage, but they need to submit a request to Head Office, which could take days. Heading to Durham Lane to assist with removing the vagrant.
Arrived on scene and approached the person of interest; he complied. (Video on file.) Standing by for security presence.
Heading to do a final welfare check on businesses before going to the office for break.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street; businesses from 2degrees and Glassons through to Farmers and Mecca all clear. Heading to Woolworths Victoria Street.
All clear at Woolworths Victoria Street; heading through Elliott Street and Darby Street.
All clear at Darby Street and Elliott Street; heading towards the Radisson.
Arrived at the Radisson; all clear, no issues to report. Heading to the office via Queen Street for break.
Arrived at the office. All clear from Timezone, Queen Street McDonald's, Unichem, Ippondo, Footlocker, The Sale Shop, Localito, Nike, Bag Planet, Cotton On and Starbucks.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:40 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Still waiting for the second guard at Headquarters; standing by for response calls while charging the Ops Phone.
Response call received from W Cosmetics regarding a female who stole a few items; gearing up and commencing patrol.

Arrived at the location; the worker showed us footage of a female (wearing grey sweatpants, a black jacket and black shoes, holding a black bag) seen taking 7–9 items. Staff believe she was wearing a wig; last seen walking down towards lower Queen Street. Commencing patrol while remaining vigilant.

Response call received from Specsavers Queen Street regarding a male vagrant (wearing a cap with the security tag still attached, last seen wearing no shoes) being violent — smashing the glasses off the shelves and breaking several of them. The workers asked us to come back on Monday morning to review the footage, as they cannot access the security footage at this time. The male was last seen walking down Queen Street towards Hallensteins. Continuing patrol down Queen Street while remaining vigilant.

Still on the lookout; patrolled through Queen Street down to Commercial Bay while checking through Victoria Street, Durham Street, Wyndham Street and Vulcan Lane — all clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrol.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing sweep. Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Continuing sweep.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols towards Albert Street.
Arrived at Albert Street; commencing welfare checks at Albert Mart Convenience Store.
All clear, no issues; continuing patrol towards Victoria Street.
Arrived on Victoria Street; welfare checks at Seven Mart Convenience Store and Countdown.
All clear, nothing to report; still on the lookout for the female and the male vagrant from the earlier response calls. Continuing patrol down Elliott Street.
Welfare check at the Elliott Street carpark, Celine's and The Food Junction, all clear. Continuing patrol towards Elliott Stables.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; standing by, maintaining our presence while remaining vigilant.
Continuing patrol from Elliott Stables to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a sweep within the area.
All clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no further issues. Continuing down Queen Street towards Fort Lane.
Commencing a sweep of Fort Lane; welfare checks at The Right Track and Jo & Joes. Standing by at The Right Track maintaining our security presence.

Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check at Britomart McDonald's. Staff said a few young kids had been mucking around in front of the store earlier but left shortly after. Standing by maintaining our presence.
Response call received from Jo & Joes regarding a male potentially passed out in front of their store; commencing patrol towards Jo & Joes.

Arrived at the location; the male was still conscious. We tried multiple times to move him from the outdoor seating area at Jo & Joes and he finally complied; we took him across the road to a nearby bench where he could sober up. Standing by maintaining our security presence in case he returns.
Still at Jo & Joes; the male is still seen lying down on the bench.
Arrived at Reign & Pour for a welfare check; all clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrol towards Lower Hobson Street.
Patrolling through Albert Street; welfare check at Albert Mart, no issues to report. Continuing patrol to Wyndham Street.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square; commencing a sweep within the area.
All clear, no issues to report; continuing through Federal Street.

Two males coming from Victoria Street were being loud and challenging members of the public to fights; as soon as they saw the HOTC guards they started behaving and calmed down, then walked off down Federal Street to their car and left. Continuing patrol on Federal Street, going down Wellesley Street West to Wellesley Street East.
Patrolling through High Street. Fireworks were going off from the Avani hotel; we notified their security about the fireworks. Standing by maintaining our security presence.
Welfare check through Aotea Square, no issues, all clear. Patrolling back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift completed; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Outside Headquarters, heading down Queen Street.
Wyndham Street intersection, all clear. Foot traffic is moderate thus far — busier than usual for a Sunday evening.
Received a potential response call; the call failed, so the caller was phoned back — the recipient relayed it was a false alarm. No further comments.
Vulcan Lane sweep, all clear. Welfare check at The Queens Ferry; behaviour satisfactory in the area at this time, closing at midnight. Moving on.

Call received from a civilian relaying that his scooter had been stolen from in front of a restaurant on Vulcan Lane; he last saw the scooter at approximately 22:00 where he had left it in front of the restaurant. The caller was advised to report his scooter stolen to the Police, as no nearby restaurants in the area had CCTV footage of the theft and there were no leads pertaining to the matter.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; conducting the usual sweep and checks in the area.
Commercial Bay all clear; a decent number of civilians in the area, in close proximity to the Viaduct. RWLC being shown at venues at the Viaduct.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; no concerns passed on to us by staff, who relayed the restaurant is busier than usual. Standing by briefly to show presence, awaiting response calls.
Standby concluded. Area is still moderately active; no cause for concern, all clear. Continuing patrols.
Sweep through Fort Lane, all clear.
Fort Street sweep, all clear. Continuing up High Street.
Vulcan Lane; checking on the caller whose scooter was stolen.

Found the caller in front of A Modo Mio, where the scooter was stolen. He relayed that a theft report has been made. Due to where the scooter was positioned, CCTV was unable to capture the theft taking place, and there were no witnesses to comment on the matter. Sweep conducted in the area, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Square; conducting sweep.
Sweep concluded. Vagrants in the area taking cover for the night; no suspicious activity in the area and no sign of the scooter. Moving along.
Durham Street East, all clear. Continuing up High Street.
Arrived at the Victoria Street East intersection; foot traffic dying down thus far on patrols. Continuing up Lorne Street heading towards the Central City Library.
Central City Library all clear; vagrants sleeping in the area, no cause for concern. Moving on.
Arrived at The Civic, all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; conducting sweep.
Aotea Square all clear; foot traffic moderate in the area, area secure. Heading back down Queen Street.
McDonald's Queen Street welfare check; staff have had no issues thus far, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters for floor checks.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed, all clear. Charging the Ops Phone, currently on 4%; awaiting response calls in the meantime.
Phone percentage sufficient to continue patrols; no response calls received in the meantime.
Back on Queen Street, heading up Victoria Street West.
Skymart welfare check; all clear, no one in store at this time. Conducting a sweep of Albert Street.
Albert Street all clear. Resuming up Victoria Street West.
77 Convenience Store welfare check; all clear, no issues, store is empty. Conducting a sweep of Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear. Heading down Victoria Street West towards Elliott Street.
Conducting a sweep through Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Elliott Street and Darby Street all clear; Atrium secured. Continuing down Queen Street.
Wyndham Street all clear; little to no foot traffic in sight at this hour.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; conducting sweep.
Sweep all clear; a few intoxicated individuals passing through the area, no cause for concern.

Staff relayed they had intoxicated individuals in the restaurant earlier; the individuals in question did not cause any trouble — they were simply intoxicated in store. Partner and I will stand by to show presence before resuming patrols, awaiting response calls in the meantime.
Standby concluded; no response calls received and no concerns thus far. Resuming patrols.
Fort Street all clear. Heading up High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Square; conducting sweep.
Freyberg Square all clear, area secured. Continuing up High Street.
Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards the Central City Library.
Central City Library all clear; the area is quiet. Moving on to The Civic.
The Civic all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Conducting a sweep at Aotea Square.
Aotea Square sweep all clear, area secured. Heading back down Queen Street.

McDonald's Queen Street all clear. Staff only complained about a group of vagrants outside the restaurant earlier in the shift; they had been static outside the front entry briefly before leaving the area. No further complaints from staff. Heading back to Headquarters for break and handover with the morning team.
At Headquarters commencing break; awaiting debrief with the morning team.

flags: CAPACITY: 12:41 Watch Group (CCTV) request to remove a vagrant sleeping at the DX Mail building entrance on Durham Lane — team advised they were currently occupied (Typo theft search) and would assist when available; attended at 13:03.

CAPACITY: Afternoon Shift — second guard had still not arrived at 14:40; the team held at HQ on standby/charging until gearing up at 16:06 in response to the W Cosmetics call (no patrols 14:30 – 16:06).
CAPACITY: Morning 08:40 – 09:40 — team held at HQ charging the Ops Phone (down to 5%); on-street patrols paused for the hour (available for calls only).

MISSING SHIFT: the raw log contains no 'Afternoon Shift Deployed' header — the 14:40 – 22:30 block is headed '[Night Shift Deployed]' (with the night equipment kit) before a second, genuine '[Night Shift Deployed]' block; the first block has been rendered as the Afternoon/Evening Shift based on its timestamps and its 22:30 'Afternoon shift has been completed' closing line.

STALE: Night Shift raw timestamps 03:05 – 03:26 (Durham West / Wyndham / Vulcan / Shortland / Fort) appear after the 03:23 – 03:29 Elliott/Darby entries, and 05:22 (Aotea sweep) appears after 05:28 (The Civic) — these times appear mistyped in the raw log; raw narrative order has been preserved.

capacity.note: Team engaged on the Typo theft search when received.
